title: Mysterious Cloaked Figure
description: A hooded figure in a flowing blue and purple cloak stands on the right side of a moss-covered stone bridge over reflective water. The dark, stormy sky features two celestial bodies, one dark and one glowing green, with lightning and swirling glowing petals surrounding the figure.
prompt: A lone hooded figure in a flowing blue and purple cloak with glowing patterns stands on an ancient moss-covered stone bridge that arches over calm reflective water. The dramatic stormy sky contains two celestial orbs, one dark and one glowing green, with lightning cracks. Swirling golden and pink petals and mist surround the figure, whose reflection is visible in the water below along with cherry blossom branches, in a surreal fantasy landscape.
